post.summary: Kicks off an asynchronous task that replicates all Keycloak organizations and their memberships into the PDC organizations cache.
post.description: Creates an `organizationSyncTask` and enqueues a background job that lists the realm's organizations and their members at the Keycloak Admin REST API using the caller's own credentials, then merges them into the local `organizations` and `user_organization_memberships` cache. The caller's JWT must carry at least one of the `view-organizations`, `manage-organizations`, or `manage-realm` realm-management roles, and at least one of the `view-users` or `manage-users` realm-management roles, mirroring the sets Keycloak accepts on the equivalent organizations and members listing calls. The sync sets `disabledAt` for organizations that Keycloak reports as deleted or not enabled and for memberships Keycloak no longer reports, rather than deleting rows. Poll `GET /organizations/sync/{organizationSyncTaskId}` for completion.

201.description: The created organization sync task, initially pending.
